ar: الأنبياء
en: Sura 21: Al-Anbiya

p.src: 21:1  The reckoning of the people has drawn near, yet they are turning away heedlessly.

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُونَ
en: The reckoning of the people has drawn near, yet they are turning away heedlessly.
u.src: 21:1  The reckoning of the people has drawn near, yet they are turning away heedlessly.

p.src: 21:2  Whenever new revelation comes to them from their Lord, they listen to it in jest,

ar: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
en: Whenever new revelation comes to them from their Lord, they listen to it in jest,
u.src: 21:2  Whenever new revelation comes to them from their Lord, they listen to it in jest,

p.src: 21:3  with their hearts heedless. The wrongdoers whisper to one another in secret, “Is this but a human being just like yourselves? Will you then follow his magic, although you openly see?”

ar: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ هَلْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ ۖ أَفَتَأْتُونَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
en: with their hearts heedless. The wrongdoers whisper to one another in secret, “Is this but a human being just like yourselves? Will you then follow his magic, although you openly see?”
u.src: 21:3  with their hearts heedless. The wrongdoers whisper to one another in secret, “Is this but a human being just like yourselves? Will you then follow his magic, although you openly see?”

p.src: 21:4  He said, “My Lord knows every word spoken in the heavens and earth, for He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.”

ar: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: He said, “My Lord knows every word spoken in the heavens and earth, for He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.”
u.src: 21:4  He said, “My Lord knows every word spoken in the heavens and earth, for He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.”

p.src: 21:5  Yet they say, “This [Qur’an] is a set of jumbled dreams! Rather, he has fabricated it! Rather, he is a poet! So let him bring us a sign just as the earlier messengers were sent with[1].”

ar: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَـٰثُ أَحْلَـٰمٍۭ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
en: Yet they say, “This [Qur’an] is a set of jumbled dreams! Rather, he has fabricated it! Rather, he is a poet! So let him bring us a sign just as the earlier messengers were sent with[1].”
u.src: 21:5  Yet they say, “This [Qur’an] is a set of jumbled dreams! Rather, he has fabricated it! Rather, he is a poet! So let him bring us a sign just as the earlier messengers were sent with[1].”

en: [1] Such as the staff of Moses (عليه السلام), the camel of Salih (عليه السلام) and the like.

p.src: 21:6  Not a single town We destroyed before them had believed[2]. Will they then believe?

ar: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ ۖ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: Not a single town We destroyed before them had believed[2]. Will they then believe?
u.src: 21:6  Not a single town We destroyed before them had believed[2]. Will they then believe?

en: [2] Although they witnessed signs and miracles.

p.src: 21:7  We did not send before you [O Prophet] except men to whom We gave a revelation, so [O people] ask the People of the Scriptures if you do not know.

ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
en: We did not send before you [O Prophet] except men to whom We gave a revelation, so [O people] ask the People of the Scriptures if you do not know.
u.src: 21:7  We did not send before you [O Prophet] except men to whom We gave a revelation, so [O people] ask the People of the Scriptures if you do not know.

p.src: 21:8  We did not give them bodies that needed no food[3], nor were they immortal.

ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ جَسَدًا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَـٰلِدِينَ
en: We did not give them bodies that needed no food[3], nor were they immortal.
u.src: 21:8  We did not give them bodies that needed no food[3], nor were they immortal.

en: [3] Such as the angels.

p.src: 21:9  Then We fulfilled Our promise to them: We saved them[4] and those whom We willed, and destroyed those who transgressed all bounds.

ar: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
en: Then We fulfilled Our promise to them: We saved them[4] and those whom We willed, and destroyed those who transgressed all bounds.
u.src: 21:9  Then We fulfilled Our promise to them: We saved them[4] and those whom We willed, and destroyed those who transgressed all bounds.

en: [4] After they conveyed the message.

p.src: 21:10  We have sent down to you [O people] a Book in which there is honor for you[5]. Do you not then understand?

ar: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَـٰبًا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
en: We have sent down to you [O people] a Book in which there is honor for you[5]. Do you not then understand?
u.src: 21:10  We have sent down to you [O people] a Book in which there is honor for you[5]. Do you not then understand?

en: [5] As you have been mentioned and addressed in the Qur’an, or there is a reminder for you in it.

p.src: 21:11  [Imagine] how many towns of wrongdoers We have destroyed[6], and raised after them another people!

ar: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
en: [Imagine] how many towns of wrongdoers We have destroyed[6], and raised after them another people!
u.src: 21:11  [Imagine] how many towns of wrongdoers We have destroyed[6], and raised after them another people!

en: [6] i.e., who were persisting in wrongdoing.

p.src: 21:12  When they sensed Our punishment, they started running away from it.

ar: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّوا۟ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ
en: When they sensed Our punishment, they started running away from it.
u.src: 21:12  When they sensed Our punishment, they started running away from it.

p.src: 21:13  “Do not run away, but return to your luxuries and dwellings[7], perhaps you will be questioned.”

ar: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَـٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
en: “Do not run away, but return to your luxuries and dwellings[7], perhaps you will be questioned.”
u.src: 21:13  “Do not run away, but return to your luxuries and dwellings[7], perhaps you will be questioned.”

en: [7] This is said to them in sarcasm and ridicule.

p.src: 21:14  They said, “Woe to us! We were indeed wrongdoers.”

ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
en: They said, “Woe to us! We were indeed wrongdoers.”
u.src: 21:14  They said, “Woe to us! We were indeed wrongdoers.”

p.src: 21:15  They kept crying this out loud until We mowed them down, lifeless[8].

ar: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَـٰمِدِينَ
en: They kept crying this out loud until We mowed them down, lifeless[8].
u.src: 21:15  They kept crying this out loud until We mowed them down, lifeless[8].

en: [8] i.e., extinguished like ashes.

p.src: 21:16  We did not create the heavens and earth and all that is between them for fun.

ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
en: We did not create the heavens and earth and all that is between them for fun.
u.src: 21:16  We did not create the heavens and earth and all that is between them for fun.

p.src: 21:17  If We had wished for a pastime[9], We could have had it from Our own, if We were to do so.

ar: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
en: If We had wished for a pastime[9], We could have had it from Our own, if We were to do so.
u.src: 21:17  If We had wished for a pastime[9], We could have had it from Our own, if We were to do so.

en: [9] Such as a wife or a child.

p.src: 21:18  Rather, We hurl the truth at falsehood, and it crushes it[10], so it vanishes. Woe to you for what you falsely ascribe [to Allah][11]!

ar: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَـٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
en: Rather, We hurl the truth at falsehood, and it crushes it[10], so it vanishes. Woe to you for what you falsely ascribe [to Allah][11]!
u.src: 21:18  Rather, We hurl the truth at falsehood, and it crushes it[10], so it vanishes. Woe to you for what you falsely ascribe [to Allah][11]!

en:
[10] Lit. "strikes its brain," disabling or killing it.
 [11] Claiming that He has a son, a wife, or a partner.

p.src: 21:19  To Him belongs all those who are in the heavens and earth. Those [angels] who are with Him are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they ever grow weary.

ar: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ
en: To Him belongs all those who are in the heavens and earth. Those [angels] who are with Him are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they ever grow weary.
u.src: 21:19  To Him belongs all those who are in the heavens and earth. Those [angels] who are with Him are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they ever grow weary.

p.src: 21:20  They glorify Him day and night tirelessly.

ar: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ
en: They glorify Him day and night tirelessly.
u.src: 21:20  They glorify Him day and night tirelessly.

p.src: 21:21  Or have they taken gods from the earth who [cannot even] resurrect the dead?

ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ
en: Or have they taken gods from the earth who [cannot even] resurrect the dead?
u.src: 21:21  Or have they taken gods from the earth who [cannot even] resurrect the dead?

p.src: 21:22  If there had been gods besides Allah in the heavens and earth, both realms would have fallen in disorder. Glory be to Allah – Lord of the Throne – far above what they ascribe [to Him].

ar: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
en: If there had been gods besides Allah in the heavens and earth, both realms would have fallen in disorder. Glory be to Allah – Lord of the Throne – far above what they ascribe [to Him].
u.src: 21:22  If there had been gods besides Allah in the heavens and earth, both realms would have fallen in disorder. Glory be to Allah – Lord of the Throne – far above what they ascribe [to Him].

p.src: 21:23  He cannot be questioned for what He does, but they will be questioned.

ar: لَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔلُونَ
en: He cannot be questioned for what He does, but they will be questioned.
u.src: 21:23  He cannot be questioned for what He does, but they will be questioned.

p.src: 21:24  Or have they taken other gods besides Him? Say, “Bring your proof. Here is the Book of those who are with me, and the Book of those who came before me[12].” Yet most of them do not know the truth, so they turn away.

ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً ۖ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ ۖ هَـٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى ۗ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
en: Or have they taken other gods besides Him? Say, “Bring your proof. Here is the Book of those who are with me, and the Book of those who came before me[12].” Yet most of them do not know the truth, so they turn away.
u.src: 21:24  Or have they taken other gods besides Him? Say, “Bring your proof. Here is the Book of those who are with me, and the Book of those who came before me[12].” Yet most of them do not know the truth, so they turn away.

en: [12] The Prophet (ﷺ) is addressed to challenge the pagans to produce their proof for the existence of other gods; whereas, the Qur’an, the Torah, and the Gospel are in agreement that there is no god but Allah alone.

p.src: 21:25  “We never sent before you [O Prophet] any messenger without revealing to him that none has the right to be worshiped except Me, so worship Me.”

ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
en: “We never sent before you [O Prophet] any messenger without revealing to him that none has the right to be worshiped except Me, so worship Me.”
u.src: 21:25  “We never sent before you [O Prophet] any messenger without revealing to him that none has the right to be worshiped except Me, so worship Me.”

p.src: 21:26  They say, “The Most Compassionate has begotten offspring!”[13] Glory be to Him! In fact, those [angels] are His honored slaves.

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًا ۗ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۚ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُونَ
en: They say, “The Most Compassionate has begotten offspring!”[13] Glory be to Him! In fact, those [angels] are His honored slaves.
u.src: 21:26  They say, “The Most Compassionate has begotten offspring!”[13] Glory be to Him! In fact, those [angels] are His honored slaves.

en: [13] The pagans claimed that angels are the daughters of Allah.

p.src: 21:27  They do not speak before He speaks, and they only do as He commands.

ar: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِۦ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: They do not speak before He speaks, and they only do as He commands.
u.src: 21:27  They do not speak before He speaks, and they only do as He commands.

p.src: 21:28  He knows what is ahead of them and what is behind them[14]. They cannot intercede except for whom He pleases, and they are fearful in awe of Him.

ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَ
en: He knows what is ahead of them and what is behind them[14]. They cannot intercede except for whom He pleases, and they are fearful in awe of Him.
u.src: 21:28  He knows what is ahead of them and what is behind them[14]. They cannot intercede except for whom He pleases, and they are fearful in awe of Him.

en: [14] See footnote 2:255.

p.src: 21:29  If anyone of them were to say, “I am god besides Him,” We would punish him with Hell. This is how We punish the wrongdoers.

ar: وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَـٰهٌ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
en: If anyone of them were to say, “I am god besides Him,” We would punish him with Hell. This is how We punish the wrongdoers.
u.src: 21:29  If anyone of them were to say, “I am god besides Him,” We would punish him with Hell. This is how We punish the wrongdoers.

p.src: 21:30  Are the disbelievers not aware that the heavens and earth were joined together and then We split them apart? We created from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَـٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: Are the disbelievers not aware that the heavens and earth were joined together and then We split them apart? We created from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?
u.src: 21:30  Are the disbelievers not aware that the heavens and earth were joined together and then We split them apart? We created from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?

p.src: 21:31  We have set on the earth firm mountains so it does not shake with them, and We have made therein broad pathways so that they may find their way.

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
en: We have set on the earth firm mountains so it does not shake with them, and We have made therein broad pathways so that they may find their way.
u.src: 21:31  We have set on the earth firm mountains so it does not shake with them, and We have made therein broad pathways so that they may find their way.

p.src: 21:32  And We have made the sky a well-protected canopy, yet they turn away from its signs[15].

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقْفًا مَّحْفُوظًا ۖ وَهُمْ عَنْ ءَايَـٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
en: And We have made the sky a well-protected canopy, yet they turn away from its signs[15].
u.src: 21:32  And We have made the sky a well-protected canopy, yet they turn away from its signs[15].

en: [15] Such as the sun and the moon.

p.src: 21:33  It is He Who created the night and the day, the sun and the moon – each floating in its orbit.

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
en: It is He Who created the night and the day, the sun and the moon – each floating in its orbit.
u.src: 21:33  It is He Who created the night and the day, the sun and the moon – each floating in its orbit.

p.src: 21:34  We did not grant immortality to any human being before you [O Prophet]. So if you die, will they live forever?

ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ ۖ أَفَإِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِدُونَ
en: We did not grant immortality to any human being before you [O Prophet]. So if you die, will they live forever?
u.src: 21:34  We did not grant immortality to any human being before you [O Prophet]. So if you die, will they live forever?

p.src: 21:35  Every soul will taste death; We test you with bad and good as a trial, then to Us you will all be returned.

ar: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً ۖ وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
en: Every soul will taste death; We test you with bad and good as a trial, then to Us you will all be returned.
u.src: 21:35  Every soul will taste death; We test you with bad and good as a trial, then to Us you will all be returned.

p.src: 21:36  When the disbelievers see you, they only take you in ridicule, [saying], “Is this the one who speaks ill of your gods?” while they reject even the mention of the Most Compassionate.

ar: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ هُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ
en: When the disbelievers see you, they only take you in ridicule, [saying], “Is this the one who speaks ill of your gods?” while they reject even the mention of the Most Compassionate.
u.src: 21:36  When the disbelievers see you, they only take you in ridicule, [saying], “Is this the one who speaks ill of your gods?” while they reject even the mention of the Most Compassionate.

p.src: 21:37  Man is created of haste. I will show you My signs, so do not ask Me to hasten them.

ar: خُلِقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ ۚ سَأُو۟رِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِى فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
en: Man is created of haste. I will show you My signs, so do not ask Me to hasten them.
u.src: 21:37  Man is created of haste. I will show you My signs, so do not ask Me to hasten them.

p.src: 21:38  They say, “When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful?”

ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
en: They say, “When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful?”
u.src: 21:38  They say, “When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful?”

p.src: 21:39  If only the disbelievers knew the moment when they would be unable to ward the Fire off their faces or their backs, nor would they be helped[16].

ar: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
en: If only the disbelievers knew the moment when they would be unable to ward the Fire off their faces or their backs, nor would they be helped[16].
u.src: 21:39  If only the disbelievers knew the moment when they would be unable to ward the Fire off their faces or their backs, nor would they be helped[16].

en: [16] The completion of the sentence is "...they would not be asking for the punishment."

p.src: 21:40  Rather, it will come upon them suddenly and stun them; they will not be able to avert it, nor will they be given respite.

ar: بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
en: Rather, it will come upon them suddenly and stun them; they will not be able to avert it, nor will they be given respite.
u.src: 21:40  Rather, it will come upon them suddenly and stun them; they will not be able to avert it, nor will they be given respite.

p.src: 21:41  Indeed, there were messengers before you who were ridiculed, but those who mocked them were encompassed by what they used to ridicule.

ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
en: Indeed, there were messengers before you who were ridiculed, but those who mocked them were encompassed by what they used to ridicule.
u.src: 21:41  Indeed, there were messengers before you who were ridiculed, but those who mocked them were encompassed by what they used to ridicule.

p.src: 21:42  Say, “Who can protect you by night and by day against the Most Compassionate?” Yet they turn away from the admonition of their Lord.

ar: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۗ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
en: Say, “Who can protect you by night and by day against the Most Compassionate?” Yet they turn away from the admonition of their Lord.
u.src: 21:42  Say, “Who can protect you by night and by day against the Most Compassionate?” Yet they turn away from the admonition of their Lord.

p.src: 21:43  Do they have gods who can defend them against Us? They cannot even help themselves, nor will they be protected from Us.

ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَا ۚ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ
en: Do they have gods who can defend them against Us? They cannot even help themselves, nor will they be protected from Us.
u.src: 21:43  Do they have gods who can defend them against Us? They cannot even help themselves, nor will they be protected from Us.

p.src: 21:44  Nevertheless, We have provided for them and their forefathers luxuries which they enjoyed for a long time. Do they not see that We gradually reduce the land from its outlying sides?[17] Is it they who will then prevail?

ar: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ ۗ أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَآ ۚ أَفَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
en: Nevertheless, We have provided for them and their forefathers luxuries which they enjoyed for a long time. Do they not see that We gradually reduce the land from its outlying sides?[17] Is it they who will then prevail?
u.src: 21:44  Nevertheless, We have provided for them and their forefathers luxuries which they enjoyed for a long time. Do they not see that We gradually reduce the land from its outlying sides?[17] Is it they who will then prevail?

en: [17] See footnote 13:41.

p.src: 21:45  Say, “I only warn you by divine revelation.” But the deaf cannot hear the call when they are warned.

ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلْوَحْىِ ۚ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ
en: Say, “I only warn you by divine revelation.” But the deaf cannot hear the call when they are warned.
u.src: 21:45  Say, “I only warn you by divine revelation.” But the deaf cannot hear the call when they are warned.

p.src: 21:46  If a mere breath of your Lord’s torment were to touch them, they would surely say, “Woe to us! We were indeed wrongdoers.”

ar: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
en: If a mere breath of your Lord’s torment were to touch them, they would surely say, “Woe to us! We were indeed wrongdoers.”
u.src: 21:46  If a mere breath of your Lord’s torment were to touch them, they would surely say, “Woe to us! We were indeed wrongdoers.”

p.src: 21:47  We will place the scales of justice on the Day of Resurrection, and no soul will be wronged in the least. Even if a deed is the weight of a mustard seed[18], We will bring it forth. Sufficient are We as Reckoners.

ar: وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَـٰسِبِينَ
en: We will place the scales of justice on the Day of Resurrection, and no soul will be wronged in the least. Even if a deed is the weight of a mustard seed[18], We will bring it forth. Sufficient are We as Reckoners.
u.src: 21:47  We will place the scales of justice on the Day of Resurrection, and no soul will be wronged in the least. Even if a deed is the weight of a mustard seed[18], We will bring it forth. Sufficient are We as Reckoners.

en: [18] i.e., as small or insignificant as a mustard seed.

p.src: 21:48  We certainly gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion, shining light and admonition[19] for the righteous,

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءً وَذِكْرًا لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
en: We certainly gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion, shining light and admonition[19] for the righteous,
u.src: 21:48  We certainly gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion, shining light and admonition[19] for the righteous,

en: [19] These are Torah’s three qualities.

p.src: 21:49  those who fear their Lord without seeing Him[20], and are apprehensive of the Hour.

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ
en: those who fear their Lord without seeing Him[20], and are apprehensive of the Hour.
u.src: 21:49  those who fear their Lord without seeing Him[20], and are apprehensive of the Hour.

en: [20] Or when they are in private and not seen by others.

p.src: 21:50  And this [Qur’an] is a blessed reminder which We have sent down. Are you still denying it[21]?

ar: وَهَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ ۚ أَفَأَنتُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
en: And this [Qur’an] is a blessed reminder which We have sent down. Are you still denying it[21]?
u.src: 21:50  And this [Qur’an] is a blessed reminder which We have sent down. Are you still denying it[21]?

en: [21] i.e., pretending ignorance or refusing to acknowledge it?

p.src: 21:51  Indeed, We had given Abraham sound judgment before[22], for We know him well.

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَـٰلِمِينَ
en: Indeed, We had given Abraham sound judgment before[22], for We know him well.
u.src: 21:51  Indeed, We had given Abraham sound judgment before[22], for We know him well.

en: [22] i.e., before Moses, or in his early youth.

p.src: 21:52  When he said to his father and his people, “What are these statues to which you are so devoted?”

ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَـٰكِفُونَ
en: When he said to his father and his people, “What are these statues to which you are so devoted?”
u.src: 21:52  When he said to his father and his people, “What are these statues to which you are so devoted?”

p.src: 21:53  They said, “We found our forefathers worshiping them.”

ar: قَالُوا۟ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَـٰبِدِينَ
en: They said, “We found our forefathers worshiping them.”
u.src: 21:53  They said, “We found our forefathers worshiping them.”

p.src: 21:54  He said, “Indeed, you and your forefathers were clearly misguided.”

ar: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: He said, “Indeed, you and your forefathers were clearly misguided.”
u.src: 21:54  He said, “Indeed, you and your forefathers were clearly misguided.”

p.src: 21:55  They said, “Have you come to us with the truth, or are you joking?”

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّـٰعِبِينَ
en: They said, “Have you come to us with the truth, or are you joking?”
u.src: 21:55  They said, “Have you come to us with the truth, or are you joking?”

p.src: 21:56  He said, “Nay, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and earth, Who created them, and I am one of those who bear witness to it.

ar: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
en: He said, “Nay, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and earth, Who created them, and I am one of those who bear witness to it.
u.src: 21:56  He said, “Nay, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and earth, Who created them, and I am one of those who bear witness to it.

p.src: 21:57  By Allah, I will surely plot against your idols after you have turned and gone away.”

ar: وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَـٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
en: By Allah, I will surely plot against your idols after you have turned and gone away.”
u.src: 21:57  By Allah, I will surely plot against your idols after you have turned and gone away.”

p.src: 21:58  So he broke them into pieces, except the biggest of them, so that they might come back to it.

ar: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ
en: So he broke them into pieces, except the biggest of them, so that they might come back to it.
u.src: 21:58  So he broke them into pieces, except the biggest of them, so that they might come back to it.

p.src: 21:59  They said, “Who has done this to our gods? He is indeed one of the wrongdoers.”

ar: قَالُوا۟ مَن فَعَلَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
en: They said, “Who has done this to our gods? He is indeed one of the wrongdoers.”
u.src: 21:59  They said, “Who has done this to our gods? He is indeed one of the wrongdoers.”

p.src: 21:60  They said, “We heard a young man, speaking ill of them, who is called Abraham.”

ar: قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ
en: They said, “We heard a young man, speaking ill of them, who is called Abraham.”
u.src: 21:60  They said, “We heard a young man, speaking ill of them, who is called Abraham.”

p.src: 21:61  They said, “Bring him then before the eyes of the people, so that they may witness [his trial][23].”

ar: قَالُوا۟ فَأْتُوا۟ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ
en: They said, “Bring him then before the eyes of the people, so that they may witness [his trial][23].”
u.src: 21:61  They said, “Bring him then before the eyes of the people, so that they may witness [his trial][23].”

en: [23] Or his confession about what he did.

p.src: 21:62  They said, “Are you the one who did this to our gods, O Abraham?”

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
en: They said, “Are you the one who did this to our gods, O Abraham?”
u.src: 21:62  They said, “Are you the one who did this to our gods, O Abraham?”

p.src: 21:63  He said, “Rather, it was this biggest one who did it. So ask them, if they can speak!”

ar: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَـٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ يَنطِقُونَ
en: He said, “Rather, it was this biggest one who did it. So ask them, if they can speak!”
u.src: 21:63  He said, “Rather, it was this biggest one who did it. So ask them, if they can speak!”

p.src: 21:64  So they turned back to one another, and said, “Indeed, it is you who are the wrongdoers.”

ar: فَرَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
en: So they turned back to one another, and said, “Indeed, it is you who are the wrongdoers.”
u.src: 21:64  So they turned back to one another, and said, “Indeed, it is you who are the wrongdoers.”

p.src: 21:65  Then they turned to their obstinacy[24], [saying], “You already know that they cannot speak.”

ar: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ
en: Then they turned to their obstinacy[24], [saying], “You already know that they cannot speak.”
u.src: 21:65  Then they turned to their obstinacy[24], [saying], “You already know that they cannot speak.”

en: [24] After first admitting their error.

p.src: 21:66  Abraham said, “Do you then worship besides Allah that which can neither benefit nor harm you in the least?

ar: قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ
en: Abraham said, “Do you then worship besides Allah that which can neither benefit nor harm you in the least?
u.src: 21:66  Abraham said, “Do you then worship besides Allah that which can neither benefit nor harm you in the least?

p.src: 21:67  Fie upon you[25] and upon all that you worship besides Allah! Do you not have any sense?”

ar: أُفٍّ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
en: Fie upon you[25] and upon all that you worship besides Allah! Do you not have any sense?”
u.src: 21:67  Fie upon you[25] and upon all that you worship besides Allah! Do you not have any sense?”

en: [25] An expression of anger and displeasure.

p.src: 21:68  They said, “Burn him and avenge your gods if you must do something.”

ar: قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
en: They said, “Burn him and avenge your gods if you must do something.”
u.src: 21:68  They said, “Burn him and avenge your gods if you must do something.”

p.src: 21:69  We said, “O fire, be cool and safe for Abraham.”[26]

ar: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
en: We said, “O fire, be cool and safe for Abraham.”[26]
u.src: 21:69  We said, “O fire, be cool and safe for Abraham.”[26]

en: [26] It is reported in an authentic Hadīth that Abraham said, while being thrown into the fire, “Allah is sufficient for us and He is the best Protector.”

p.src: 21:70  They plotted to harm him, but We made them the worst losers.

ar: وَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ
en: They plotted to harm him, but We made them the worst losers.
u.src: 21:70  They plotted to harm him, but We made them the worst losers.

p.src: 21:71  And We saved him and Lot [and brought him] to the land[27] that we have blessed for all people.

ar: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
en: And We saved him and Lot [and brought him] to the land[27] that we have blessed for all people.
u.src: 21:71  And We saved him and Lot [and brought him] to the land[27] that we have blessed for all people.

en: [27] i.e., the Levant. Abraham and his nephew, Lot, were saved from their enemy Nimrod and his people, as they migrated from the land of Babel, Iraq to Jerusalem.

p.src: 21:72  And We gave him Isaac, and then Jacob, a grandson, and We made all of them righteous.

ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةً ۖ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صَـٰلِحِينَ
en: And We gave him Isaac, and then Jacob, a grandson, and We made all of them righteous.
u.src: 21:72  And We gave him Isaac, and then Jacob, a grandson, and We made all of them righteous.

p.src: 21:73  And We made them leaders, guiding people by Our command, and We inspired them to do righteous deeds, establish prayer and give zakah[28]; and they were Our true worshipers.

ar: وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا عَـٰبِدِينَ
en: And We made them leaders, guiding people by Our command, and We inspired them to do righteous deeds, establish prayer and give zakah[28]; and they were Our true worshipers.
u.src: 21:73  And We made them leaders, guiding people by Our command, and We inspired them to do righteous deeds, establish prayer and give zakah[28]; and they were Our true worshipers.

en: [28] The term "zakah" denotes purification and growth.

p.src: 21:74  To Lot We gave sound judgment and knowledge, and We saved him from the town that was engrossed in shameful practices. They were Indeed an evil and rebellious people.

ar: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَت تَّعْمَلُ ٱلْخَبَـٰٓئِثَ ۗ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَـٰسِقِينَ
en: To Lot We gave sound judgment and knowledge, and We saved him from the town that was engrossed in shameful practices. They were Indeed an evil and rebellious people.
u.src: 21:74  To Lot We gave sound judgment and knowledge, and We saved him from the town that was engrossed in shameful practices. They were Indeed an evil and rebellious people.

p.src: 21:75  And We admitted him to Our mercy, for he was one of the righteous.

ar: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
en: And We admitted him to Our mercy, for he was one of the righteous.
u.src: 21:75  And We admitted him to Our mercy, for he was one of the righteous.

p.src: 21:76  And [remember] Noah, when he called out[29] to Us before, so We responded to him and saved him and his household[30] from the great distress.

ar: وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
en: And [remember] Noah, when he called out[29] to Us before, so We responded to him and saved him and his household[30] from the great distress.
u.src: 21:76  And [remember] Noah, when he called out[29] to Us before, so We responded to him and saved him and his household[30] from the great distress.

en:
[29] i.e., supplicated against his people who had persisted in denial.
 [30] i.e., the believers of his household.

p.src: 21:77  And We helped him against the people who rejected Our signs. They were indeed evil people, so We drowned them all.

ar: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: And We helped him against the people who rejected Our signs. They were indeed evil people, so We drowned them all.
u.src: 21:77  And We helped him against the people who rejected Our signs. They were indeed evil people, so We drowned them all.

p.src: 21:78  And [remember] David and Solomon, when they passed judgment about the tillage into which some people’s sheep had strayed at night[31], and We were witnesses to their judgment.

ar: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى ٱلْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَـٰهِدِينَ
en: And [remember] David and Solomon, when they passed judgment about the tillage into which some people’s sheep had strayed at night[31], and We were witnesses to their judgment.
u.src: 21:78  And [remember] David and Solomon, when they passed judgment about the tillage into which some people’s sheep had strayed at night[31], and We were witnesses to their judgment.

en: [31] Destroying the crops and eating therefrom.

p.src: 21:79  We made Solomon understand it[32], although We gave each of them sound judgment and knowledge. We subjected the mountains and birds to glorify Allah along with David. It was We Who did all this.

ar: فَفَهَّمْنَـٰهَا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا ۚ وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَٱلطَّيْرَ ۚ وَكُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
en: We made Solomon understand it[32], although We gave each of them sound judgment and knowledge. We subjected the mountains and birds to glorify Allah along with David. It was We Who did all this.
u.src: 21:79  We made Solomon understand it[32], although We gave each of them sound judgment and knowledge. We subjected the mountains and birds to glorify Allah along with David. It was We Who did all this.

en: [32] A man’s flock of sheep strayed into another man’s tillage. When the two men came to David for judgment, he ruled that the shepherd must give his sheep in compensation for the damage. Nonetheless, Solomon suggested that the sheep be kept with the owner of the tillage, so he may benefit from their milk and wool, while the shepherd should work on the land to restore it to its former state. Thus, the farmer would take back his tillage in perfect condition, and the sheep would be returned to its owner. David was impressed by his son’s insightful and fair judgment and approved it.

p.src: 21:80  And We taught him[33] the art of making coats of mail for you to protect yourselves in your battle. Will you then be grateful?

ar: وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُمْ شَـٰكِرُونَ
en: And We taught him[33] the art of making coats of mail for you to protect yourselves in your battle. Will you then be grateful?
u.src: 21:80  And We taught him[33] the art of making coats of mail for you to protect yourselves in your battle. Will you then be grateful?

en: [33] i.e., David apart from Solomon.

p.src: 21:81  And to Solomon [We subjected] the raging wind, to blow by his command to the land We had blessed. It is We Who have full knowledge of everything.

ar: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ
en: And to Solomon [We subjected] the raging wind, to blow by his command to the land We had blessed. It is We Who have full knowledge of everything.
u.src: 21:81  And to Solomon [We subjected] the raging wind, to blow by his command to the land We had blessed. It is We Who have full knowledge of everything.

p.src: 21:82  And among the devils [We subjected] those who dived for him[34] and performed other duties. It is We Who were watching over them[35].

ar: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
en: And among the devils [We subjected] those who dived for him[34] and performed other duties. It is We Who were watching over them[35].
u.src: 21:82  And among the devils [We subjected] those who dived for him[34] and performed other duties. It is We Who were watching over them[35].

en:
[34] Bringing him pearls.
 [35] Preventing any disobedience from Solomon's instructions and protecting him from being harmed by them.

p.src: 21:83  And [remember] Job, when he cried out to his Lord, “I have been struck by adversity[36], and You are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.”

ar: وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
en: And [remember] Job, when he cried out to his Lord, “I have been struck by adversity[36], and You are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.”
u.src: 21:83  And [remember] Job, when he cried out to his Lord, “I have been struck by adversity[36], and You are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.”

en: [36] i.e., loss of health, wealth, and children.

p.src: 21:84  So We responded to him and relieved his adversity, and We restored to him his family, twice as many, as a mercy from Us and as a reminder for Our worshipers.

ar: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرٍّ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَـٰبِدِينَ
en: So We responded to him and relieved his adversity, and We restored to him his family, twice as many, as a mercy from Us and as a reminder for Our worshipers.
u.src: 21:84  So We responded to him and relieved his adversity, and We restored to him his family, twice as many, as a mercy from Us and as a reminder for Our worshipers.

p.src: 21:85  And [remember] Ishmael, Idrīs and Dhul-Kifl[37]; they were all steadfast.

ar: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
en: And [remember] Ishmael, Idrīs and Dhul-Kifl[37]; they were all steadfast.
u.src: 21:85  And [remember] Ishmael, Idrīs and Dhul-Kifl[37]; they were all steadfast.

en: [37] Idrīs (Enoch); Dhul-Kifl (Ezekiel, or Isaiah).

p.src: 21:86  And We admitted them to Our mercy, for they were truly righteous.

ar: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
en: And We admitted them to Our mercy, for they were truly righteous.
u.src: 21:86  And We admitted them to Our mercy, for they were truly righteous.

p.src: 21:87  And [remember] the Man of the Whale [i.e., Jonah] when he departed in anger[38], thinking that We would not take him to task. Then he cried out in the depths of darkness[39], “None has the right to be worshiped except You. Glory be to You! I have certainly done wrong”.

ar: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَـٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
en: And [remember] the Man of the Whale [i.e., Jonah] when he departed in anger[38], thinking that We would not take him to task. Then he cried out in the depths of darkness[39], “None has the right to be worshiped except You. Glory be to You! I have certainly done wrong”.
u.src: 21:87  And [remember] the Man of the Whale [i.e., Jonah] when he departed in anger[38], thinking that We would not take him to task. Then he cried out in the depths of darkness[39], “None has the right to be worshiped except You. Glory be to You! I have certainly done wrong”.

en:
[38] Due to the disbelief of his people.
 [39] The darkness of the night, the sea, and the whale's belly.

p.src: 21:88  So We answered his prayer and rescued him from distress. This is how We rescue the believers.

ar: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: So We answered his prayer and rescued him from distress. This is how We rescue the believers.
u.src: 21:88  So We answered his prayer and rescued him from distress. This is how We rescue the believers.

p.src: 21:89  And [remember] Zachariah, when he cried out to his Lord, “My Lord, do not leave me childless, for You are the Best of Inheritors.”

ar: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
en: And [remember] Zachariah, when he cried out to his Lord, “My Lord, do not leave me childless, for You are the Best of Inheritors.”
u.src: 21:89  And [remember] Zachariah, when he cried out to his Lord, “My Lord, do not leave me childless, for You are the Best of Inheritors.”

p.src: 21:90  So We answered his prayer and gave him John, and made his wife fertile. They used to hasten in doing good deeds and used to call upon Us with hope and fear, and they were humble before Us.

ar: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُۥ زَوْجَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا خَـٰشِعِينَ
en: So We answered his prayer and gave him John, and made his wife fertile. They used to hasten in doing good deeds and used to call upon Us with hope and fear, and they were humble before Us.
u.src: 21:90  So We answered his prayer and gave him John, and made his wife fertile. They used to hasten in doing good deeds and used to call upon Us with hope and fear, and they were humble before Us.

p.src: 21:91  And [remember Mary] who guarded her chastity; We breathed in her [garment] through Our Spirit [Gabriel] and made her and her son a sign for all people.

ar: وَٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا وَٱبْنَهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
en: And [remember Mary] who guarded her chastity; We breathed in her [garment] through Our Spirit [Gabriel] and made her and her son a sign for all people.
u.src: 21:91  And [remember Mary] who guarded her chastity; We breathed in her [garment] through Our Spirit [Gabriel] and made her and her son a sign for all people.

p.src: 21:92  Indeed, this religion of yours is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me alone.

ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
en: Indeed, this religion of yours is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me alone.
u.src: 21:92  Indeed, this religion of yours is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me alone.

p.src: 21:93  But people have divided themselves into sects, yet they will all return to Us.

ar: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَٰجِعُونَ
en: But people have divided themselves into sects, yet they will all return to Us.
u.src: 21:93  But people have divided themselves into sects, yet they will all return to Us.

p.src: 21:94  Whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer, his efforts will not be denied[40], for We are recording them all.

ar: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ كَـٰتِبُونَ
en: Whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer, his efforts will not be denied[40], for We are recording them all.
u.src: 21:94  Whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer, his efforts will not be denied[40], for We are recording them all.

en: [40] i.e., He will not be deprived of his due reward.

p.src: 21:95  It is not possible for any town that We have destroyed to ever come back [to this world][41],

ar: وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
en: It is not possible for any town that We have destroyed to ever come back [to this world][41],
u.src: 21:95  It is not possible for any town that We have destroyed to ever come back [to this world][41],

en: [41] To repent to Allah.

p.src: 21:96  until when Gog and Magog are let loose, swarming swiftly from every mound,

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنسِلُونَ
en: until when Gog and Magog are let loose, swarming swiftly from every mound,
u.src: 21:96  until when Gog and Magog are let loose, swarming swiftly from every mound,

p.src: 21:97  when the True Promise[42] draws near, the eyes of those who disbelieved will stare in horror, [saying], “Woe to us! We were indeed heedless of this; nay, we were wrongdoers.”

ar: وَٱقْتَرَبَ ٱلْوَعْدُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِىَ شَـٰخِصَةٌ أَبْصَـٰرُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
en: when the True Promise[42] draws near, the eyes of those who disbelieved will stare in horror, [saying], “Woe to us! We were indeed heedless of this; nay, we were wrongdoers.”
u.src: 21:97  when the True Promise[42] draws near, the eyes of those who disbelieved will stare in horror, [saying], “Woe to us! We were indeed heedless of this; nay, we were wrongdoers.”

en: [42] i.e., the Hereafter.

p.src: 21:98  Indeed, you and all that you worship besides Allah will be the fuel for Hell; you will surely enter it.

ar: إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمْ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ
en: Indeed, you and all that you worship besides Allah will be the fuel for Hell; you will surely enter it.
u.src: 21:98  Indeed, you and all that you worship besides Allah will be the fuel for Hell; you will surely enter it.

p.src: 21:99  If these [idols] had truly been gods, they would not have entered it. But they will all abide therein forever.

ar: لَوْ كَانَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةً مَّا وَرَدُوهَا ۖ وَكُلٌّ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
en: If these [idols] had truly been gods, they would not have entered it. But they will all abide therein forever.
u.src: 21:99  If these [idols] had truly been gods, they would not have entered it. But they will all abide therein forever.

p.src: 21:100  They will groan therein with anguish, and they will not be able to hear anything.

ar: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
en: They will groan therein with anguish, and they will not be able to hear anything.
u.src: 21:100  They will groan therein with anguish, and they will not be able to hear anything.

p.src: 21:101  But those for whom We have decreed the finest reward, they will be far away from it.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلْحُسْنَىٰٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ
en: But those for whom We have decreed the finest reward, they will be far away from it.
u.src: 21:101  But those for whom We have decreed the finest reward, they will be far away from it.

p.src: 21:102  They will not hear its slightest hissing, and they will abide forever in whatever their souls desire.

ar: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا ۖ وَهُمْ فِى مَا ٱشْتَهَتْ أَنفُسُهُمْ خَـٰلِدُونَ
en: They will not hear its slightest hissing, and they will abide forever in whatever their souls desire.
u.src: 21:102  They will not hear its slightest hissing, and they will abide forever in whatever their souls desire.

p.src: 21:103  They will not be grieved by the Greatest Terror[43], and the angels will receive them [saying], “This is your Day that you were promised”.

ar: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ ٱلْفَزَعُ ٱلْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ هَـٰذَا يَوْمُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
en: They will not be grieved by the Greatest Terror[43], and the angels will receive them [saying], “This is your Day that you were promised”.
u.src: 21:103  They will not be grieved by the Greatest Terror[43], and the angels will receive them [saying], “This is your Day that you were promised”.

en: [43] i.e., the events of the Day of Resurrection.

p.src: 21:104  On the Day when We roll up the heavens like a scroll of records. Just as We originated the first creation, so We will bring it back. That is Our binding promise, which We will surely do.

ar: يَوْمَ نَطْوِى ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَىِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ ۚ كَمَا بَدَأْنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُّعِيدُهُۥ ۚ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
en: On the Day when We roll up the heavens like a scroll of records. Just as We originated the first creation, so We will bring it back. That is Our binding promise, which We will surely do.
u.src: 21:104  On the Day when We roll up the heavens like a scroll of records. Just as We originated the first creation, so We will bring it back. That is Our binding promise, which We will surely do.

p.src: 21:105  We have written in the Psalms[44] after the Preserved Record[45], that the land will be inherited by My righteous slaves.

ar: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِى ٱلزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلذِّكْرِ أَنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِىَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ
en: We have written in the Psalms[44] after the Preserved Record[45], that the land will be inherited by My righteous slaves.
u.src: 21:105  We have written in the Psalms[44] after the Preserved Record[45], that the land will be inherited by My righteous slaves.

en:
[44] i.e., the Scriptures.
 [45] i.e., after inscribing it in al-Lawh al-Mahfūz.

p.src: 21:106  Indeed, there is a message in this [Qur’an] for devoted worshipers.

ar: إِنَّ فِى هَـٰذَا لَبَلَـٰغًا لِّقَوْمٍ عَـٰبِدِينَ
en: Indeed, there is a message in this [Qur’an] for devoted worshipers.
u.src: 21:106  Indeed, there is a message in this [Qur’an] for devoted worshipers.

p.src: 21:107  We have not sent you [O Prophet] except as a mercy to the worlds.

ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
en: We have not sent you [O Prophet] except as a mercy to the worlds.
u.src: 21:107  We have not sent you [O Prophet] except as a mercy to the worlds.

p.src: 21:108  Say, “It is only revealed to me that your God is only One God; will you then submit to Him?

ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
en: Say, “It is only revealed to me that your God is only One God; will you then submit to Him?
u.src: 21:108  Say, “It is only revealed to me that your God is only One God; will you then submit to Him?

p.src: 21:109  But if they turn away, say, “I have proclaimed the message to you all alike[46], and I do not know whether what you are warned of[47] is near or far.

ar: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُلْ ءَاذَنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍ ۖ وَإِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ
en: But if they turn away, say, “I have proclaimed the message to you all alike[46], and I do not know whether what you are warned of[47] is near or far.
u.src: 21:109  But if they turn away, say, “I have proclaimed the message to you all alike[46], and I do not know whether what you are warned of[47] is near or far.

en:
[46] i.e., We and you know that there is no peace between us.
 [47] i.e., the punishment.

p.src: 21:110  Indeed, He knows what is said openly and knows what you conceal.

ar: إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ
en: Indeed, He knows what is said openly and knows what you conceal.
u.src: 21:110  Indeed, He knows what is said openly and knows what you conceal.

p.src: 21:111  I do not know; perhaps this [delay][48] is a test for you[49] and an enjoyment for a while.”

ar: وَإِنْ أَدْرِى لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتْنَةٌ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَـٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
en: I do not know; perhaps this [delay][48] is a test for you[49] and an enjoyment for a while.”
u.src: 21:111  I do not know; perhaps this [delay][48] is a test for you[49] and an enjoyment for a while.”

en:
[48] i.e., this postponement of punishment.
 [49] To increase sin.

p.src: 21:112  [The Prophet] said, “My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. Our Lord is the Most Compassionate Whose help is to be sought against what you describe[50].”

ar: قَـٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
en: [The Prophet] said, “My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. Our Lord is the Most Compassionate Whose help is to be sought against what you describe[50].”
u.src: 21:112  [The Prophet] said, “My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. Our Lord is the Most Compassionate Whose help is to be sought against what you describe[50].”

en: [50] i.e., of lies and disbelief.
